propositions: Three independent detached-child spawn sites duplicate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, stdio discipline, and cwd logic; a defect (missing cwd argument) propagated across all three copies
A single spawn_detached() helper in _proc.py must consolidate the three sites' bootstrap and platform flags while preserving per-caller exception handling, environment projection, and logging
The static test must enforce that detached spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste propagation
_proc.py must remain a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar.* imports, while spawn_detached() accepts caller-supplied env and re-raises on failure
A fourth concurrent copy-paste site (gc_trigger.py) must be consolidated into the helper; spawn_detached() must generalize to variadic args with consistent cwd anchoring on the first argument
